newsitem.title: USA: Dow index soars 104 points to new high.
newsitem.headline: Dow index soars 104 points to new high.

text.p: The Dow Jones industrial average rocketed nearly 104 points to a new high Tuesday as Wall Street grew increasingly confident that corporate profits will be strong in the second quarter.

Based on early and unofficial data, the Dow gained 103.81 points, or 1.32 percent, to close at 7,962.31, putting it less than 40 points from the 8,000 mark. Its old record finish was set Thursday at 7,895.81.
In the broader market, advancing issues led declines 16-11 on active volume of 529 million shares on the New York Stock Exchange.
